items.name: cordage
items.description: Strips of rag twisted into a short, strong cord. Good for lashing one thing to another.

items.name: wire
items.description: A coil of soft wire, hammered and drawn out of scrap. It ties things down, and one day it will carry current.

items.name: metal plate
items.description: Scrap hammered flat and folded over on itself into a rough plate. Heavy, and far more use than a handful of scrap.

items.name: hull patch kit
items.description: A hammered plate with a rag gasket round its edge and wire to lash it in place: enough to stop a hole in the hull you could put your fist through.
